name: com.tencent.qcloud.tuikit.tuicallkit.manager.bridge.Initializer
description: Android runs this Tencent Cloud TRTC TUICallKit Provider when the app starts. It registers the call and voice-message recording services and signals the kit to restore a floating call view when a call is already active.
disableEffect: The call services will not be registered here, and an active call cannot return to its floating view through this initializer.
